display_title: Don't Be So Kind to Me!
mangabaka_title: Don't Be So Kind to Me!
native_title: 優しくしないでください! ～妖精の祝福で冷酷公爵に溺愛されています～

titles.title: Don't Be So Kind to Me!
優しくしないでください! ～妖精の祝福で冷酷公爵に溺愛されています～

description:
Edith Hamilton, the daughter of a lower-ranking noble family, loves painting and dreams of someday starting a family with a kindhearted man.

However, one day, she comes to deeply regret helping a fairy in the royal palace gardens!

"May the most handsome man in the world treat you with kindness and affection!"

Thanks to this completely unwanted blessing, Marquis Yurick Glassheart, a man notorious for his coldhearted nature, suddenly begins treating her with genuine kindness!

Desperate to break the blessing, Edith tries everything she can. But despite her efforts, Yurick's affection only grows more intense by the day...

Dear God, please lift this blessing—no, this curse! And please punish that fairy while you're at it!

All I want is to marry a kindhearted man and make my dreams come true!
